content.comment_body: Has anyone used the [version_no] web server to display [product_name] variables? Is it possible to use the [version_no] as a frontend for a small network of [product_name] modules?

Yes, it's possible to display [product_name] variables on the [version_no] web server. I transferred the IB0 of [product_name] to [version_no] DB1.DBB0. On the web server, the status of DB1.DBX0.0, DB1.DBX0.1, DB1.DBX0.2, and so on, was visible.
That's great to hear. I'm planning to get the 10.5 to [version_no] upgrade so I can try this myself.

analysis.insight_summary: Users discussed displaying [product_name] variables on the web server interface of [version_no]. A user confirmed successful integration and visualization of data, indicating that [version_no] can act as a frontend for monitoring a network of [product_name] modules. The key insight highlights interoperability and web-based monitoring between these hardware components.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect direct and hassle-free integration between [version_no] and [product_name] modules, enabling easy variable monitoring using the [version_no] web server. Reliable and clear visualization of [product_name] data within the [version_no] platform is desired.
